status: Service-scope research draft, not verified Sazo policy or import permission
manual_review: Inspect sampled titles and attributes before any new inference. Overrides require a recorded product-fact-based reason, never labels/predictions. Do not silently replace rejected sampled products.
hard_cases: Keep in-scope mixed materials, sets, parts, inconsistent/missing attributes, ambiguous product facts and damaged/used descriptions; no difficulty filtering.
sampling: Exclude previous 94 pilot IDs from fresh validation pool, then fixed SHA256(scope-v1|ID) order, balanced round-robin across eligible top categories, 96 maximum; sampling before reading new predictions or reference labels.
limitations: Personal use inferred from product type, not verified purchaser intent. Text-only input. Category-balanced sample not marketplace-frequency representative. Country/HS edition differences persist. Original benchmark labels are US expert references, not Korean customs rulings.
